◉ IRIS — Intelligent Realism & Image Synthesis — v1.8

CROSS-PLATFORM IMPLEMENTATION

SUPPORTED DESKTOP HOSTS
- macOS: .command, .sh, or Python launcher
- Windows: .bat, PowerShell, or Python launcher
- Linux: .sh or Python launcher

PORTABLE CORE
The authoritative launcher uses Python 3 standard-library components only. It binds only to 127.0.0.1 and serves the local Batch Studio or Visual Workspace. It searches a small local port range if the preferred port is occupied.

START
macOS: double-click IRIS_v1.8_RUN.command or run ./IRIS_v1.8_RUN.sh visual
Windows: IRIS_v1.8_RUN.bat visual
PowerShell: ./IRIS_v1.8_RUN.ps1 visual
Linux: ./IRIS_v1.8_RUN.sh visual
Portable: python IRIS_v1.8_LAUNCH.py visual
Batch Studio: replace visual with batch.

MOBILE / TABLET
iOS/iPadOS and Android can use the static HTML workspaces when hosted by an authorized local/server environment, but this package does not claim native background Python execution on those platforms. The web UI remains responsive/browser-compatible; native packaging is a separate deployment target.

PROVIDER BOUNDARY
Image generation remains provider-adapter based. Cross-platform launch support does not falsely claim that a generation provider is configured.

GLOBAL FORGE DELEGATION
Global EDEN FORGE remains the technical/deterministic implementation specialist. IRIS contains no active local IRIS.FORGE or FOUNDRY worker.
